title: Resolved text recipe options
description: What `mdux-textbake` was asked to do when baking one locale's text package: the font its runs were positioned against, the locale, and how many strings it carries. Describes the **resolved** option set a baker records in `report.json`'s `options`, with every default expanded - not the literal TOML a recipe file carries. ADR-007 decision 4 is why: a silently changed default must not leave every report looking unchanged, so the report records what the bake actually did, and this documents that. Checked against every committed report by tools/docs-lint/check_schema_type_drift.py.

id.description: The artifact id, which names the directory under `generated/text/`.

font.description: Repository-relative path to the committed font package the runs were measured against.

atlas.description: The font package id the runs index glyphs in. Checked against `font`: an id alone could not be read, and a path alone could be swapped for another package without the recipe saying so.

locale.description: The BCP 47 tag this package is the text for. Must be one the font approves.

sidecar.description: The file the positioned glyph runs are written to, beside `package.json`.

strings.description: How many keys the package carries. A count rather than the keys themselves: the keys are in the package, and a report records what the bake did rather than duplicating its output.
